records.name: MPI SENTIO晶圆探针台
records.description: 这是一类用于半导体晶圆测试的自动或半自动探针台系统，可对晶圆卡盘进行XY、Z和旋转定位，并支持接触/分离高度控制、真空吸附、晶圆地图步进与可选热卡盘功能。该设备常用于晶圆级电学测量、器件表征、失效分析以及带有自动装载、显微镜或硅光子对准模块的测试流程。
records.description_en: This is an automatic or semi-automatic wafer prober used for semiconductor wafer testing. It provides XY, Z, and rotational chuck positioning, contact/separation height control, vacuum holding, wafer map stepping, and optional thermal chuck capability. It is commonly used for wafer-level electrical measurements, device characterization, failure analysis, and test workflows with optional auto-loading, microscope, or silicon photonics alignment modules.

records.name: Newport XPS高性能运动控制器
records.description: Newport XPS 系列通用高性能多轴运动控制平台，支持复杂轨迹和同步控制。
records.description_en: Newport XPS is a universal high-performance multi-axis motion control platform for complex trajectory and synchronized control tasks.

records.name: Nobø Ecohub 供暖控制集线器
records.description: 用于 Nobø 电采暖系统的网络集线器，可在局域网中发现并连接供暖分区与组件，管理周程序、舒适/节能/离家等覆盖模式，并读取分区或组件温度，适合实验室房间供暖与环境温度管理。
records.description_en: A network-connected hub for Nobø electric heating systems. It can discover and connect heating zones and components on a local network, manage weekly schedules and comfort/eco/away overrides, and read zone or component temperatures for room heating and environmental temperature management in labs.

records.name: PLC限位到限位插入式运动机构
records.description: 一种由PLC控制的简单一维插入/退出运动机构，在两个机械限位之间运动，用于将部件插入或移出实验位置或光路。此类装置常用于束线或实验站中的简单定位、联锁演示和运动控制测试。
records.description_en: A simple PLC-controlled one-dimensional in/out motion device that travels between two mechanical limit positions. It is used to insert or retract a component from an experimental position or beam path, commonly for basic positioning, interlock demonstrations, and motion-control testing in beamline or laboratory setups.

records.name: PV位置控制组件
records.description: 用于通过过程变量接口执行位置设定与状态读写的非物理控制组件，可作为上层运动控制的抽象接口。
records.description_en: A non-physical control component that sets positions and reads/writes status through process-variable interfaces, acting as an abstraction for higher-level motion control.

records.name: SPIDR连接的Timepix/Medipix像素探测器
records.description: 通过SPIDR读出系统连接的Timepix/Medipix像素探测器设备，用于配置像素矩阵、DAC、测试脉冲、时序和网络读出参数，服务于粒子、辐射或高速成像实验的数据采集。
records.description_en: A Timepix/Medipix pixel detector connected through the SPIDR readout system, used to configure the pixel matrix, DACs, test pulses, timing, and network readout parameters for data acquisition in particle, radiation, or fast imaging experiments.

records.name: Thorlabs APT通信端口
records.description: 用于Thorlabs APT位移台/控制器通信的非物理软件组件。它负责通过串口样式端口发送和接收消息、运行消息处理循环、提供文件描述符访问，并读取控制器序列号、通道数量及已连接平台信息，适合在实验自动化中管理单控制器或卡槽式控制器的通信连接。
records.description_en: A non-physical software component for communicating with Thorlabs APT motion-stage controllers. It sends and receives protocol messages over a serial-style port, runs the message-processing loop, exposes the file descriptor, and retrieves controller serial number, channel count, and connected stage information for automation workflows involving single-controller or card-slot controllers.

records.name: Timepix/Medipix 像素探测器
records.description: 用于控制 Timepix/Medipix 像素探测器的高层接口，可配置像素阈值、掩膜、测试脉冲和多项 DAC 偏置参数，并执行设备设置、采集启动/停止、数据记录及以太网通信配置，适用于辐射探测、粒子成像和时间相关测量实验。
records.description_en: A high-level control interface for a Timepix/Medipix pixel detector. It supports configuring pixel thresholds, masks, test pulses, and multiple DAC bias parameters, as well as device setup, acquisition start/stop, data recording, and Ethernet communication settings for radiation detection, particle imaging, and time-related measurements.

records.name: Timepix/SPIDR像素探测器采集系统
records.description: 用于连接SPIDR并初始化、控制一个或多个Timepix像素探测器的采集系统，可设置偏置电压、启动或停止采集、通过轮询或回调接收数据，并将采集数据记录到文件。
records.description_en: An acquisition system for connecting to SPIDR and initializing and controlling one or more Timepix pixel detectors. It supports bias voltage control, starting and stopping acquisition, receiving data by polling or callback, and recording acquired data to files.

records.name: Timepix4 像素探测器
records.description: 用于实验中 Timepix4 像素探测器的控制与数据采集，可加载配置、设置像素阈值/掩膜/测试参数、管理以太网数据过滤，并启动、停止和记录探测数据。
records.description_en: Controls a Timepix4 pixel detector for laboratory data acquisition, including loading configuration, setting pixel threshold/mask/test parameters, managing Ethernet data filtering, and starting, stopping, and recording detector data.

records.name: Universal Robots 协作机械臂
records.description: Universal Robots机械臂设备，用于实验室精密操作和自动化作业。该设备集成了UR机械臂本体、Robotiq夹爪和RTDE通信接口，支持六自由度精确运动控制和力觉反馈。具备实时位置监控、状态反馈、轨迹规划等功能，可执行复杂的多点位运动任务。适用于样品抓取、精密装配、实验器具操作等需要高精度和高重复性的实验室自动化场景。

records.name: iCL42 步进电机驱动器
records.description: iCL42步进电机驱动器，用于实验室设备的精密线性运动控制。该设备通过串口通信控制iCL42型步进电机驱动器，支持多种运动模式和精确的位置、速度控制。具备位置反馈、运行状态监控和故障检测功能。适用于自动进样器、样品传送、精密定位平台等需要准确线性运动控制的实验室自动化设备。

records.name: 三轴运动平台示例装置
records.description: 这是一个基于 PLC 控制逻辑的三轴运动平台示例装置，包含模拟的 X、Y、Z 运动以及若干离散状态位。它主要用于实验室或束线控制系统中演示和测试运动控制、限位行为、状态切换以及与上位控制系统的集成。
records.description_en: This is an example PLC-controlled 3-axis motion stage with simulated X, Y, and Z motion and several discrete state positions. It is mainly used in laboratory or beamline control environments to demonstrate and test motion control, limit behavior, state changes, and integration with higher-level control systems.

records.name: 东洋 XYZ 三轴运动平台（仿真）
records.description: 东洋XYZ三轴运动平台，基于MoveIt2运动规划框架的精密定位设备。该设备通过ROS2和MoveIt2实现三维空间的精确运动控制，支持复杂轨迹规划、多点定位、速度控制等功能。具备高精度定位、平稳运动、实时轨迹监控等特性。适用于精密加工、样品定位、检测扫描、自动化装配等需要高精度三维运动控制的实验室和工业应用场景。

records.name: 光束剖面强度监视器
records.description: 用于束线诊断的光束剖面强度监视器。该设备通过Y向插入/移出机构将YAG靶或二极管送入光路，并结合变焦机构和面阵探测器来观察光束形貌与强度分布；部分变体还带有调焦或LED照明功能。
records.description_en: A beam diagnostics profile intensity monitor. It inserts or retracts a YAG target or diode into the beam path via a Y-axis mechanism, and uses zoom optics with an area detector to observe beam profile and intensity distribution; some variants also include focus control or LED illumination.
